exchange_command: python3 scripts/benchmark_apply_followup.py --variants parents exchange --cases flat128 parents8 parents128 --no-watch --batch-rounds 6 --output .exchange-results
historical_btrfs_command: python3 scripts/benchmark_apply_followup.py --variants pre-group baseline --cases tiny large --no-watch --small-rounds 24 --output .historical-small

parents.note: Scratch policy, Git failure reporting, and multiple existing parents; creations and deletions remain reference.

exchange.note: Isolated exchange prototype on frozen parents; not production; patch retained in experiments/applyexchange.

baseline.note: Committed P1 plus the new workload benchmark; production unchanged.

scratch.note: P1 plus scratch-only publication policy and Git operational-error correction; original single-parent grouping.

pre-group.note: Historical pre-P1 source plus same apply workload without group instrumentation. No backup-data fix. Compare one-root only; fsnotify dependency differs.

note: Main campaigns used the driver frozen in parents inputs; subsequent campaigns used driver.py (adds --cases only). Production code matches parents inputs; the later additional parent-barrier test is validated separately. Main report reference A/B is committed P1; exchange reference is parents; historical-small reference is pre-group. Campaigns do not overlap on a host. Historical pre-group fsnotify dependency differs, but that comparison runs only apply benchmarks, not watchers.
